## What

<!-- Scope and nature of the change, in a sentence or two: what a caller, a visitor or an operator sees differently once this merges. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem, bug or missing behaviour that motivated the work, and the tradeoffs taken — the alternative rejected, the constraint that forced the design. Nobody can reconstruct this from the diff. -->

## How

<!-- The technical approach and architecture decisions, so a reviewer understands the solution before opening the diff. Name the files, functions and migrations that carry it. Bullets for multi-step logic. -->

## Testing

<!-- Commands run, environment, edge cases covered — and honestly what was not. Required: if the change was not verified beyond CI, say that. -->
